deduplicate_crystal_structures: deduplicate a pandas DataFrame of crystal structures using hash-based pre-filtering and parallel crystallographic comparison
deduplicate_and_remove_duplicates: deduplicate crystal structures in a DataFrame and remove duplicate entries keeping one representative per group
process_structure_group: apply crystallographic deduplication to a pre-filtered group of structures using StructureMatcher with configurable tolerances
review_deduplicate_structures: review the deduplicate_structures function to understand its two-stage hash-based pre-filtering and parallel comparison algorithm
refactor_process_structure_group: refactor the process_structure_group function to use a different clustering strategy instead of greedy connected components
